newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets add-on cellular contract.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets add-on cellular contract.

text.p: Motorola Inc said its International Cellullar Infrastructure Group signed a contract valued at more than $7 million to expand the digital cellular network in Kuwait.
The Mobile Communications Co expansion project, when completed, will provide service to more than 116,000 subscribers in Kuwait City, Jahra, and Ahmadi.
The expansion is scheduled for completion by early 1997.
Motorola initially signed a digital cellular contract in November 1994 to develop a digital cellular system to serve 50,000 subscribers in Kuwait.
